response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, demonstrated leadership in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, and deep exposure to cloud platforms and data systems — aligning well with core requirements. However, his resume lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, direct RAG/vector DB implementation, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph, and his education stops at a BS, which may limit perceived depth for a staff-level GenAI role.
strengths: Experience with AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling at re:cinq
Proven track record in cloud-native development (AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker) and data pipelines
Strong technical leadership through workshops, open-source projects, and cross-functional mentoring
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years focused on production-grade AI/GenAI systems
Missing explicit experience with vector databases or RAG architecture implementations
Limited mention of multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI) or LLM optimization metrics
